description: Decisive test of bridge versus tail on the large-seed instrument. Run E108 code (340ecc1: 2@16 + 1.75@24 at bs 1536, then 1.25@28 + 2.5@32 at bs 1024, everything else as E100) untimed through the benchmark trial code on seeds 3-102, one fresh process. Pair it per seed against the E100 vector from the H4.6.1 calibration run. Gate: run only after H4.6.1 has produced its baseline and SE. Precondition, untimed: log the source hash and a one-line diff against 176e5ec. Scored row: rerun E100 unchanged, which adds another distinct gate sample (also useful to H4.8).
